status: pre-registered 2026-10-07, before the protocol runs (README.md, 'Criteria'); revised 2026-10-11 for decision D39 (criteria for an exactly imposed law, Contact_line_law_enforcement=Strong)
law_enforcement_note: Decision D39: the Ren-E law V = gamma M (cos(theta_e) - cos(theta_d)) is imposed exactly at the contact points (Contact_line_law_enforcement=Strong), so the wall fluid speed equals the law by construction and the fluid law error is reported only. The test is whether the transported interface follows the imposed speed: the geometric contact-line speed (centred difference of the wall zero crossings of phi_h over the outputs) against the law at the measured angle.
geometric_rms_relative_error_note: Decision D39: RMS over the measurement window and both contact points of (V_geometric - V_RenE(theta_d)) / |V_RenE(theta_d)| at most 10%, at every level of the dt0/4 mesh study (R/h = 8, 16, 32), for the advancing and the receding case. Replaces the earlier finest-level gate on both the fluid and the geometric error.
geometric_mean_signed_relative_error_not: Decision D39: the mean over the window samples of the signed relative geometric error lies within +/-2% at every level of the dt0/4 mesh study, for both cases. Replaces the strict decrease of the errors with h (the strongly imposed law leaves errors near a floor, without a monotone trend).
displacement_self_convergence: Reported, not gated (D39): the mean outward contact-line displacement at t = 0.25 at R/h = 8, 16, 32 (dt0/4), the changes between successive levels, their ratio and the observed order.
fluid_law_error: Reported, not gated (D39): RMS and mean signed relative error of the wall fluid speed against the law.
max_displacement_change_halving_dt_note: At R/h = 32, the mean outward contact-line displacement at t = 0.25 changes by at most 2% between dt0/2 and dt0/4.
signs: Every window sample of every run: the wall fluid speed and the geometric speed have the sign of the Ren-E prediction (advancing positive).
max_area_drift_note: Maximum relative change of the exact P1 liquid area over the run, every run (decision D11).
completion: Every run reaches its end time; an outer fixed-point cap failure is recorded and retried once with Outer_fixed_point_relaxation_start_pass=1 (every update relaxed) for diagnosis only (the retry is not a protocol result).

superseded_weak_law_criteria.finest_rms_relative_error_note: RMS over the measurement window and both contact points of |V_measured - V_RenE(theta_d)| / |V_RenE(theta_d)|, for the wall fluid speed and for the geometric contact-line speed, at R/h = 32 and dt0/4, for the advancing and the receding case.
superseded_weak_law_criteria.mesh_convergence: At dt0/4 both RMS errors decrease strictly from R/h = 8 to 16 to 32 (l_s/h = 2, 4, 8 with the physical slip length fixed).
superseded_weak_law_criteria.note: The 2026-10-07 criteria for the weakly imposed law (Contact_line_law_enforcement=Weak, the earlier decks); verify.py --law-criteria weak applies them.
